panels.title: Publisher ETH Balance
panels.description: Current ETH balance of the L1 publisher address. Below 0.2 ETH is critical (cannot publish).

panels.title: L2 Block Height (tip)
panels.description: Latest proposed L2 block (chain tip) the archiver has seen.

panels.title: L2 Block Height (proven)
panels.description: Latest proven L2 block. Lags the proposed tip by the proving horizon.

panels.title: ETH Hours Remaining
panels.description: Estimated hours until publisher balance reaches zero at the current burn rate.

panels.title: L1 Block Height
panels.description: Highest L1 (Ethereum) block the archiver has processed.

panels.title: Peer Count
panels.description: Connected Aztec P2P peers. Too few peers risks missing proposals/attestations.

panels.title: Mempool Txs
panels.description: Transactions currently held in the node's mempool.

panels.title: Slot Fill Rate (1h)
panels.description: Fraction of this validator's assigned slots that produced a block in the last hour. Below 80% means missed slots.

panels.title: World State Errors (15m)
panels.description: Critical world-state / Merkle-DB errors in the last 15m. Any value > 0 may indicate state corruption.

panels.title: Block Height Over Time
panels.description: L2 proposed/proven tips and the L1 height the archiver has reached, over time.

panels.title: Blob Tx Results
panels.description: Successful vs failed blob submissions to L1 per interval.

panels.title: Rollup Proofs & Synced Blocks
panels.description: Rollup proofs submitted on L1 and blocks synced from L1.

panels.title: Chain Reorgs (prune count)
panels.description: Archiver chain pruning events = L2 reorgs. Sustained reorgs indicate consensus/L1 instability.

panels.title: Slot Fill Rate Over Time
panels.description: Assigned slots that produced a block. < 80% = missing slots (offline, slow attestation gathering, or build failures).

panels.title: Attestation Collection Time
panels.description: Time to collect committee attestations for a proposed block. Aztec alerts when this exceeds ~20s.

panels.title: Attestation Failures
panels.description: Attestations this node failed to produce, split by node-issue vs bad-proposal cause.

panels.title: Block Proposal Failures
panels.description: Block build/proposal failures by error type, excluding the benign insufficient_txs case.

panels.title: L1 Tx Failures
panels.description: L1 publish failure modes: reverted, cancelled (replaced), or never mined.

panels.title: Publisher ETH Balance
panels.description: Publisher ETH balance over time. Threshold lines mark the 0.2 (critical) and 1.0 (warning) levels.

panels.title: ETH Burn Rate (per hour)
panels.description: Rate of ETH consumption. Negative means the balance is decreasing.

panels.title: L1 Gas Price (Gwei)
panels.description: Average L1 gas price paid for publisher transactions. Directly drives the ETH burn rate.

panels.title: Geth Status
panels.description: Whether the local Geth execution client is responding (from check-geth-health.sh).

panels.title: Geth Block Number
panels.description: Latest block seen by the local Geth node.

panels.title: Geth Peers
panels.description: Geth connected peer count. Few peers risks stale L1 data.

panels.title: Geth Sync
panels.description: Geth sync status (synced vs still catching up).

panels.title: Keystore Queue
panels.description: Available keystores for new delegations. Keep 10+ in the queue.

panels.title: New Delegations (last check)
panels.description: Queue decrease since the last delegation check. Positive = new delegations consumed keystores.
